convention_differences: Martin highlights the storefront TAG boxes on the plan (A, B, C, D) in the system color; I highlighted the openings only.
Martin marks the frame-type LABEL (F1, F4, F5, F6) with a '1 Thus' Qty box beside it; I highlighted the whole frame drawing and the schedule rows, with the Qty box at the schedule row.
On elevations Martin places only the Area (W/H/SF); I added a highlight and door circle too.
Martin leaves overhead doors, awnings and HM doors blank; I marked them red as considered-and-excluded.
Martin highlights detail titles on A-6.1 in Ext SF orange even for the interior S.F. details; I used Int SF (same orange in the toolbox).
mine_only_judgment: Break metal to match storefront at jamb/sidelite (3/A-6.2) and door jamb (2/A-6.2) — touches our frame, matches our finish. Martin marked only the sill flashing on A-6.1.
Double aluminum head filler at the storefront door head (5/A-6.2) — Martin marked the detail title, not the note.
